Friendly tidy intact fantasy village, welcoming Halloween crafts, no dark red/black horror, no blood or decay. Detailed materials and outer neighborhood life without cluttering the fighting floor. No yellow wall panel. Floor design: diagonal bands of closely laid small diamond paving and cream herringbone work lanes, subtle muted pastel wrapper diamond inlays flush into stones, a light broad S-shaped working street across the open center. Its huge central paved yard feels like a candy cooling yard, with distinct rotated masonry and long diagonal lane rhythm, not L13's fan/junction. No actual sugar rack or vat in the interior.
